selection_basis: Frozen minimum training validation loss checkpoint; improved every mode on clean and scan validation. Supplementary sequence validation exposed a fallback state bug, fixed without modifying weights or labels. Independent tests were not used to reselect a checkpoint.

metric_definitions.core_exact_rate: Exact measure metadata, rhythm and note fields together. Metadata includes time, tempo, key, feel, bars, repeats and directions.
metric_definitions.exact_match_rate: Canonical M2 equality, additionally including techniques and other encoded content.
metric_definitions.scope: Task metrics use ground-truth crops. Gold and predicted-context tests are different fixed selections, not a causal comparison.

evaluation_reuse.reason: Identical adapter bytes, manifest hash, selection and decoding parameters

evaluation_reuse.method: Every reused row has identical image, previous context, decoding budget and fallback under the corrected runtime; all affected sequences rerun from measure 1. No expected target is used to repair any prediction.
